text:
elaine: T-minus 90m to change window. Soft-freeze in 30m. Quick status check: canaries, pins, rollback owners, release notes link?

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for service-embedder v2.4.1 -> 5% traffic. Logs: ```[canary] started on host g-12, pid 4321```

riley: Watching canary dashboards (latency / error budget). I'll call it at T-15 if anything spikes.

mike: I pinned v2.4.1 to pool-prod-edge (3 nodes) to prevent auto-swap. Pin id: pin-0452

sam: Release notes published https://redwood/docs/releases/2026-03-21-v2.4.1 :notes: includes embedding perf improvements and kv-cache tweak.

ben: Rollback owners: @riley (primary) @mike (secondary). Escalation path in case of partial failures.

elaine: If canary p50 >200ms for 3 consecutive minutes OR errors >0.5% over 10m -> rollback to v2.3.9. Confirm we have rollback command ready.

mike: Adding runbook snippet: ```# rollback to v2.3.9
deployctl promote --service=embedder --version=v2.3.9 --timeout=10m
# unpin if pinned: deployctl unpin --id=pin-0452```

riley: ACK. I'll trigger rollback and notify @oncall if threshold hits. I'll also pause canary traffic with routing -> 0% before promote.

deploy-bot: Pin applied (pin-0452), canary traffic set to 5%, metric hooks active. Next milestone: increase to 20% at T+10m if stable.

sam: Heads-up: analytics runbook expects a stable window for daily jobs at +1h. If we rollback, data job can be retried.

elaine: Good. Last ask: who runs post-launch smoke? @mike you on web/API, @sam on analytics, @riley on embeddings. :thumbsup: 

mike: On it. Smoke checklist: health endpoints, simple query, embedding sanity, token billing sanity.

riley: Monitoring alert thresholds set. I'll post a short status update at T-5m and again at T+15m.

ben: LGTM — standing by.

elaine: Alright. Soft-freeze starts in 30. No merges except proven hotfixes. Post here for any exemption requests.

sam: If anyone needs an exemption for docs-only change (tiny typo), DM me and I'll coordinate :white_check_mark:

riley: Canary p50=95ms, errors=0.01% (T-10m check)

deploy-bot: Canary traffic scaled to 20% (safety increase). Keep an eye on p95.

mike: p95 210ms on one pod, investigating heat on g-12.

riley: I'm seeing a CPU spike on g-12, moving traffic off that host.

elaine: If that recovers in 3m, continue. If not, rollback plan in effect. Keep comms terse.

riley: Traffic shifted, p95 back to 130ms, errors normal. Holding at 20%.

elaine: Thanks — proceeding to launch window. Keep this thread for all pin/unpin/rollback activity.
